purpose: Teach: キャロル/スクルージ/兵衛/モモ/ポップス/社民党/アントニオ/ピエール

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、クリスマス・キャロル英語で読んでたな
lines.en: You were reading A Christmas Carol in English, weren't you?
lines.style: Light, teasing lob. Playful accusation with a knowing smile. She's caught him in something harmless and she's enjoying it. Quick tempo, bright attack on the opening word.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、スクルージみたいに節約してたな、桜
lines.en: Yeah? You were being all frugal like Scrooge yourself, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry deflection. Quick counter-volley without real edge. There's affection underneath the snark. Slight drawl on the comparison, like he's been waiting to use it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会で兵衛さんの名前出てきたな
lines.en: You brought up Heibei's name in that history essay, didn't you?
lines.style: Still probing, still playful. The accusation is lighter now — she's building a pattern. Slightly slower than her first line, savoring the observations. Conspiratorial tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、モモジュースばっか飲んでたな、桜
lines.en: Oh come on — you were drinking nothing but peach juice back then, Sakura.
lines.style: Gentle counter. Not defensive, just matter-of-fact. A small laugh underneath. He's remembering something specific and kind. Warm, unhurried pace.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ポップス聴きながら勉強してたな
lines.en: You were studying with pop music blasting the whole time, weren't you?
lines.style: Sharper this time. She's picking up momentum. Quick jab with real precision — she's noticed more than he realized. Slight challenge in her tone, daring him to deny it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会で社民党習ったろ?桜
lines.en: Wait — didn't you learn about the Social Democratic Party in history? Sakura?
lines.style: Turns the tables. Gentle challenge back. He's been listening. Slight uncertainty in the question mark — testing her memory now. Warmer, less defensive than his other volleys.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、アントニオ猪木のモノマネしてたな
lines.en: You were doing your Antonio Inoki impression again, weren't you?
lines.style: Grin in her voice. She's delighted by his dorkiness. Quick, bright delivery with a bit of mischief. She's calling him out for something genuinely ridiculous and loving it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ピエール瀧の映画観てたな、桜
lines.en: You watched that Pierre Taaki movie, though, Sakura.
lines.style: Final close. Softer than his other lines. He's been keeping score and this one lands differently — less teasing, more genuine. Almost tender. Slight trailing-off, like he's surprised at his own memory.
